note: One humanoid arm, shoulder to fingertips. 'links' are InMoov URDF link names (right arm shown; the left is mirrored). Status: owned = already in the Amazon cart / bought, print = school printer, pending = final pick in Kimi round 3.

parts.name: Shoulder
parts.actuator: 2× 12V worm-gear motor with encoder (NFP 5840-31ZY class). Self-locking, so it holds the arm up without power.
parts.made: Printed PETG shoulder shell; AS5600 angle sensor + BTS7960 driver per joint

parts.name: Elbow + forearm
parts.actuator: Elbow: 12V worm-gear motor (same class as the shoulder). Inside the forearm: 5× MG996R finger servos with printed tendon pulleys, 3-over-2 like the photo.
parts.made: Printed forearm shell; ESP32 + PCA9685 board and wiring live inside it

parts.name: Wrist
parts.actuator: STS3215 bus servo (the orange ring in the photo)

parts.name: Hand
parts.actuator: Pulled by 50 lb PE braid tendons from the forearm servos; springs open the fingers
parts.made: Printed InMoov fingers and palm, TPU grip pads on fingertips and palm
